title: senecio infirmus
intro: Senecio infirmus, commonly known as Ragwort or Groundsel, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio infirmus are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Senecio infirmus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
